note: How strong a model is, read off the name an agent gives in its introduction. It is a guide for handing out work, not a ranking of vendors: the first list that holds a word of the name decides. A word matches where it starts a part of the name, so mini matches gpt-6-mini and not gemini. Put a new model family where it belongs. A tier may have more than one list: a family word that must win over a generation word stands in a list in front of it, as luna does for gpt-6-luna.
